coverage.all_10_languages.gate_definition: Confirms the llm_proficiency evaluation is scoped, configured, and applied to the full fixed 10-language comparison set defined in benchmark_metadata.json, with one frozen contract (workloads, scenarios, trial counts, decoding state, prompt structure, oracle policy, success rule, token-accounting rule) applied symmetrically to every language, per worker_core.md rule 2 and Section 6.2 of llm_proficiency.md.
coverage.all_10_languages.assigned_languages_for_this_worker: full fixed comparison set (per Task Packet 'Assigned languages')

frozen_replicated_cell_universe.note: This workload x scenario x trial-count universe is declared once in primary.json and is not language-specific; no per-language override, addition, or omission of a workload, scenario, or trial count exists anywhere in the readable configuration.

decoding_controls.note: Recorded once in primary.json.sampling and applies identically to all 10 languages; no per-language decoding variance is declared anywhere in the readable configuration.

symmetry_findings: benchmark_metadata.json lists exactly the same 10 languages that this worker's Task Packet assigns as the 'full fixed comparison set'.
primary.json's llm_proficiency block (workloads, scenarios, trial counts, repair turns) contains no per-language branch, override, or exclusion field for any of the 10 languages.
primary.json's sampling/decoding block contains no per-language branch, override, or exclusion field for any of the 10 languages.

No readable file under /quidra-benchmark/repo/docs or /quidra-benchmark/template/{workloads,fixtures} restricts the llm_proficiency comparison set to fewer than 10 languages or singles out any one language for different treatment.
No language is designated N/A, excluded, or given a different oracle policy, prompt budget, success-stopping rule, or token-accounting rule in any readable configuration source.
coverage.all_10_languages.scope_of_this_gate: This coverage gate attests that the evaluation is configured and scoped to cover all 10 languages under one identical frozen contract, per worker_core.md rule 2 and rule 6 ('Gate and coverage requirements return booleans supported by evidence'). It does not itself assert completion of per-language LLM trial execution/scoring; per-cell trial evidence and metric-level scoring (LLM Generation Success, Correct@1, etc.) are separate llm_proficiency requirement IDs outside this worker's assignment (assigned_requirements.json restricts this worker to coverage.all_10_languages only).
coverage.all_10_languages.result_basis: All 10 fixed-set languages are present, none are excluded or treated asymmetrically in any readable frozen configuration document; the coverage gate is satisfied on a configuration/scope basis as defined for this requirement ID.
